part.text:
Done. Zero-dependency Node project set up:

- `src/range-to-regex.js` — core logic (`rangeToRegex`, `rangeToRegexSource`, `parseRange`, `rangeToRegexFromString`)
- `bin/cli.js` — `npm start -- 1-100` prints `^(?:[1-9]|[1-9][0-9]|100)$`
- `test/range-to-regex.test.js` — exhaustively verifies boundaries; `npm test` passes (4/4)

The algorithm splits the range at powers-of-ten boundaries, then compresses each fixed-width segment into digit classes. Handles edge cases like leading zeros (rejected) and `0-255` → `[0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5]`.
